topic: Volcanic eruption materials and PHIVOLCS alert levels
key_concepts: Volcanoes are vents from which molten rock erupts onto Earth's surface
Volcanic eruptions release pressure and gases
Philippine volcanoes can erupt lava, ash, and ballistic projectiles unpredictably
Magma is molten rock beneath Earth's surface; lava is molten rock on the surface
Volcanic mountains form from accumulated layers of lava, ash, and other materials
Effusive eruptions are weak while explosive eruptions are violent
Explosive eruptions release pyroclastic materials, ashfall, volcanic bombs, and volcanic g
Lahar is a mudflow caused by torrential rains on unconsolidated deposits from previous eru
Ash consists of volcanic particles smaller than 2 mm in diameter
Pyroclastic flows, surges, ashfall, lahars, volcanic gases, and lava flows are volcanic ha
PHIVOLCS Volcano Monitoring Alert Levels classify volcanic activity and guide safety actio
Following alerts from authorities can reduce the impacts of unpredicted eruptions
